# Project Nightfall

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [HANDOFF.md](../HANDOFF.md) for shared project context.

This is an existing multiplayer game: CommonJS Node HTTP/WebSocket server, browser JavaScript, and Three.js 0.160.1. Preserve the authoritative server and existing game features. Run `npm test` for code changes and inspect browser captures for visual/gameplay changes. There is no build command.

First priorities are visible, intentional targeting; readable boss encounters; and improving the repetitive urban arena and interim infected art. Coordinate file ownership with Codex before editing. Keep gameplay claims grounded in actual play, preserve asset credits, and never assume a GitHub commit is already live on Render.
